what: GHOSTKEY is ONE trust root + keyring (RGHOSTKEY · ЯWALLET · RTRACKR · ASSM, the lab's ROS signing method). Private keys are never merged or moved: 'signed by GHOSTKEY' = signed by the root key OR by an ACTIVE member key of a ring the root signed, for the op requested.

<fp>

<sha256>' with field device=<fp>. Size + sha256 always checked. A label ('ghostkey', 'owner-command', 'source', 'device') without a signature is REFUSED.

authorization.label: ghostkey
authorization.note: A GHOSTKEY label is informational; the signature is what counts.

root.name: GHOSTKEY root (Rizal owner key, ЯCASKET / Face ID)

ring_signature.status: PENDING: Rizal signs this ring once with the root e5833fdfbbfe (sidecar ghostkey.json.sig.json, kind 'ghostkey', id 'ghostkey-ring', name 'ghostkey.json'). Until then apps use the ring PINNED in their verifier.

pinning: Apps pin this ring in code. A remote ring replaces the pinned one ONLY if its root-signed sidecar verifies (size + sha256 + ed25519). Public keys only; bots never hold any key.
source_of_member_keys: ASSM-RSYNC data/trusted-devices.json on the Neo (Rizal-edited; ACTIVE P-256 device public keys from rsync-core deviceSigner()). fp = first 12 hex of sha256(raw 65-byte key).
revoke: Set a member's status to REVOKED (or remove it), bump version, Rizal re-signs the ring; verifiers refuse it immediately.
